title.zh: 免费 + BYOK，不卖数据、不投广告
title.en: Free + BYOK — no data selling, no ads

body.zh: Community 完整可用；AI 用量走你自己的 Key。Pro 从 V2 起提供，卖同步与便利，不解锁基础能力。
body.en: Community is fully usable; AI usage goes through your own key. Pro arrives with V2, selling sync and convenience rather than unlocking basics.

sub.zh: 不卖数据、不投广告；数据可迁移，随时带走。
sub.en: No selling your data, no ads; your data stays portable, take it anytime.
